row: Hooves & Paws Animal Rescue is a no-kill, nonprofit animal rescue that saves the lives of abused and abandoned animals.  The Hooves & Paws sanctuary is currently home to over 150 animals, including dogs, horses and farm animals.  Support our work today and help make a difference for animals!
